market_summary: Strong risk-off and dollar strength drive heavy downside trends across XAUUSD and BTCUSD, while GBPUSD remains compressed inside its session value area. Both Gold and Bitcoin are severely stretched below their lower ATR envelopes and Value Area Lows, testing major liquidity levels (XAUUSD near Put Wall #1/Session Low, BTC sweeping Session Lows). Due to mean-reversion risk and extended conditions, all symbols warrant HOLD.

signals.rationale: Price is significantly below VAL (3943.91) and below POC (3978.0). CVD is BEARISH (-7.82) with negative slope (-0.89) agreeing with the downtrend. Market is in LONDON_NY_OVERLAP session. Trend is firmly bearish below VWAP (3957.06) and EMA50 (3948.65). ATR bands are expanding with price riding near the lower ATR band (3903.71). Heavy RVOL spikes printed on the recent waterfall drop, though the latest bar sits at 1.58 RVOL. Price recently bounced slightly from Session Low (3882.79) with Put Wall #1 at 3872.18 looming directly below. GEX is NEGATIVE_AMPLIFYING below Gamma Flip (3949.51), but selling directly into major Put Wall #1 and the local bottom after an extended 80-dollar drop lacks immediate R:R buffer without a pullback. HOLD for cleaner retest.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish below downward sloping VWAP and EMA50
signals.level_event: acceptance below VAL testing Session Low

signals.rationale: Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 1.32587 to VAH 1.32766) and below POC (1.32726). CVD is BEARISH (-7,448) but short-term slope is positive (+692.19), indicating divergence and absorption. Market is in LONDON_NY_OVERLAP. Price is oscillating tightly around VWAP (1.32658) and EMA50 (1.32678), indicating lack of clear directional momentum. Price is sitting mid-channel between ATR upper (1.32821) and lower (1.32492). RVOL is normal (1.468, no recent yellow spike). Price is testing local support at Prev Low (1.32618) and S/R (1.32661) without clear expansion. GEX is null. Value area chop dictates a HOLD.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: neutral hovering around VWAP and EMA50

signals.rationale: Price is trading well below VAL (73239.0) and below POC (73510.98). CVD is BEARISH (-0.08) with negative slope (-0.02). Market session is LONDON_NY_OVERLAP. Trend is deeply bearish well below declining VWAP (73294.74) and EMA50 (73169.80). Price extended well past the lower ATR band (72146.51), showing extreme stretch. While the previous breakdown had RVOL > 2.0 (yellow spike 5 bars ago), the signal candle swept down to 71656.6 (Session Low) and the forming candle is now rebounding strongly (+330 points off the low) back inside the lower ATR band. GEX is null. Entering a short here chases an oversold extension into a liquidity sweep bounce, while buying fights a heavy macro trend. HOLD is prudent.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish steep selloff below VWAP and EMA50
